newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan problems loans moving towards solution -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan problems loans moving towards solution -- BOJ.

text.p: The total amount of problem loans at Japan's financial institutions is steadily decreasing, and Japan is moving towards solving the issue, Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Monday.

"The issue of problem loans at our financial institutions is generally moving steadily towards a solution. It is important to regain credibility in our financial system at home and abroad by quickly completing the disposal of remaining problem loans," Matsushita told a meeting of BOJ branch managers.
As one way of promoting an efficient and stable financial system, the BOJ had started considering implementing a real-time gross settlement system between commercial banks and the BOJ, he said.
